name: CSI-Text Multimodal Alignment Benchmark
description: The first CSI-Text multimodal dataset with many-to-many pairing for benchmarking language-grounded ambient perception from WiFi signals.

distribution.name: CSI-Text_Multimodal_Alignment_GitHub
distribution.description: Training code, configs, preprocessing, and evaluation protocols.

distribution.name: HuggingFace_Hub_dataset
distribution.description: Dataset card and release artifacts on the Hugging Face Hub (URL finalized at publication).

distribution.name: Kaggle_dataset
distribution.description: Mirror and metadata on Kaggle (URL finalized at publication).

distribution.name: csi_text_pairs.jsonl
distribution.description: Line-delimited manifest of CSI-text records (columns referenced by the primary record set). Tensor values may be stored by reference to HDF5 in full releases.

recordSet.name: csi_text_pairs
recordSet.description: Homogeneous records linking normalized CSI amplitude tensors to natural-language descriptions, task names, class indices, and source dataset identifiers.

field.name: sample_id
field.description: Stable identifier for one CSI segment in the unified schema.

field.name: csi_data
field.description: CSI amplitude tensor [C, K, T] (float32), or a reference path into bundled HDF5 when tensors are not inlined in JSONL.

field.name: text_descriptions
field.description: Associated text descriptions for many-to-many alignment (list of strings or newline-separated field in the manifest).

field.name: task
field.description: Sensing task name (e.g., har, sign_recognition, fall_detection).

field.name: label
field.description: Integer class label within the task.

field.name: source_dataset
field.description: One of csibench, xrf55, or signfi.
